verdict.rationale: Docs show createTool() from @mastra/core/tools with id, description, typed inputSchema/outputSchema (zod), and execute function, plus agents are configured simply via {id, name, instructions, model} and can be given tools directly, matching the 'few lines of code, typed custom tools' story. Community feedback corroborates ease of use and TypeScript-first developer experience, though clunkiness with complex branching is noted elsewhere (not central to this story). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on code sample showing full agent+tool wiring end-to-end, only doc snippets.
